Hi Ava —

Appreciate the clear ask. Attached is a compact MAP draft (MAP-Draft-v3.pdf) and an execution worksheet (nova-smoke-tests.xlsx) with owners and durations. Below is the summary lattice / decision flow we propose — designed to map to your procurement checkpoint on 2027-09-10.

1) Objective success metrics (pass if ALL met)
   - Latency: 95th percentile token latency <= 120ms for standard requests (batch size 1) over a 24h window.
   - Functional accuracy: Task-level concordance >= 92% on your labeled probe set (70 examples per critical intent).
   - Safety/PII: Zero high-severity data leaks in the red-team subset; any hit triggers immediate hold.
   - Throughput: Sustained 100 rps for 1 hour during a load test with no error rate > 0.5%.

2) Exit gates (fail-fast)
   - Immediate stop: any safety high-severity or PII leakage discovered.
   - Hold-and-investigate: 95th latency > 200ms for 2 consecutive 1-hour windows.
   - Conditional pass: accuracy between 88-92% — requires an agreed remediation plan and a 1-week follow-up retest.

3) Acceptance tests (owners + duration)
   - Smoke functional run (owner: Nova product, duration: 2 days) — basic end-to-end prompts + critical intents.
   - Concordance sweep (owner: Redwood QA, duration: 3 days) — labeled probe set, automated scoring (sheet attached).
   - Load & latency (owner: Redwood infra, duration: 1 day) — ramp to 100 rps, monitor 95p latency and error rates.
   - Safety review (owner: Nova security + Redwood trust, duration: 3 days) — red-team subset, manual review and tooling scans.

4) Decision lattice (how we get to a go/no-go)
   - Green path: all metrics met => mutual signoff => proceed to Dedicated capacity pilot (slice deployment) => procurement moves to contract execution.
   - Amber path: one or more conditional criteria (e.g., accuracy 89-91%) => remediation sprint (owner assigned) + retest window of 7-10 days. If remediated, proceed; if not, re-evaluate scope or model variant.
   - Red path: safety or severe stability failure => immediate pause; joint postmortem and no further ramp until cleared.

5) Rollforward / rollback guidance
   - Rollforward: staged capacity increase with 10% increments every 24h while monitoring business KPIs and error budget.
   - Rollback: pinned model version + traffic split to fallback model (pre-agreed) if error budget breached or safety issue discovered. Redwood will keep a warm compatible variant for instant fallback.

Next steps: if this summary matches your expectations we'll update the MAP PDF with your procurement labels and owners. Marcus: flag if we need an SLA excerpt for the procurement packet.

Cheers,
Grace O'Connor
